notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.notes:
[h1]We have released an update for the game![/h1]

[h2]List of changes:[/h2]

[list]
[h3][*] Furry animation has been fixed.
[*] Fixed UI in Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Polish.
[*] Added VHS camera filter in the lobby.[/h3]
[/list]

[h2]Achievements:[/h2]
[h3][list]
[*] Added two achievements
[/list][/h3]

[h2]In the near future we plan to release a map update and add some interesting mechanics.[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44894499/0eb764d9445d886bb5e649f4a9205dbf4ee8b61d.png[/img]

[h2]We are also working on creating a new level. Write in the comments what you would like to see at the new location.[/h2]

[b][h2]Have a nice game![/h2][/b]
